title: Lean 4 formalization of Sections 2–3 of Lavi's proof of Foregger's conjecture
description:
A sorry-free Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Section 2 (Lemmas 2.1–2.5), Section 3 (Lemmas 3.1–3.2 and equations (3.5)–(3.7)) and the cycle-support case of Y. Lavi, Foregger's Conjecture on Minimum Permanents of Nearly Decomposable Doubly Stochastic Matrices (preprint, 2026). The main theorems depend only on Lean's standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), and the files contain no sorry, admit, axiom or native_decide.

The formalization also records several simplifications: the cofactor equalities (2.1) hold at a minimizer on any face, with no connectivity hypothesis; Lemma 2.4 follows from an expansion lemma (splitting a merged line preserves strict Hall) together with Lemma 2.3; the Lemma 2.5 classification needs no noncycle hypothesis; Lemma 3.1 is proved by an interior-minimizer perturbation argument without Lagrange multipliers or Sinkhorn scaling; and Lemma 3.2 holds for any endpoint-preserving merge map, without the entropy chain rule.

Scope. Sections 4–7 of the preprint (tight cuts, Gurvits's capacity bound, the one-star bound, tight-cut leaves and the induction) are not formalized. This record is therefore not a machine-checked proof of Foregger's conjecture.

The Lean code was developed with AI coding assistants (Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's Codex), working under the author's direction. Lean's kernel checks every proof.
